_comment: 20 unique companion NPCs. Like Bannerlord's wanderers: named, backstoried, hireable.

companions.name: Marcus Reed
companions.title: The Ex-Cop
companions.backstory: 15 years on the force. Quit when the precinct went crooked. Knows every street in Columbus.

companions.name: Sofia Marchetti
companions.title: The Fixer
companions.backstory: Ran numbers for the family. Now runs them for herself. Nothing happens in Hamilton she doesn't know about.

companions.name: Chen Wei
companions.title: The Doctor
companions.backstory: ER surgeon before the collapse. Now patches up whoever can pay. Steady hands, steady nerve.

companions.name: Kim Jisoo
companions.title: The Sniper
companions.backstory: Competition shooter. Olympic trials before everything fell apart. Can thread a needle at 200 yards.

companions.name: Sean O'Brien
companions.title: The Brawler
companions.backstory: Bare-knuckle champ, three counties. Drinks too much, hits too hard, loyal to the bone.

companions.name: Maria Santos
companions.title: The Driver
companions.backstory: Drove trucks cross-country for a decade. Knows every back road from Lexington to Cincinnati.

companions.name: Dmitri Volkov
companions.title: The Engineer
companions.backstory: Soviet-trained combat engineer. Came over in the 90s. Can breach anything or build anything.

companions.name: Hans Mueller
companions.title: The Quartermaster
companions.backstory: Logistics officer, Army Reserve. Runs supply like a Swiss watch. Nothing wasted, nothing lost.

companions.name: Jamal Carter
companions.title: The Scout
companions.backstory: Grew up running packages through Dayton. Knows every alley, rooftop, and shortcut.

companions.name: Li Mei
companions.title: The Herbalist
companions.backstory: Traditional medicine practitioner. Her remedies work when the pharmacies are empty.

companions.name: Patrick Kelly
companions.title: The Enforcer
companions.backstory: Debt collector for the wrong people. Now collects for the right ones. Usually.

companions.name: Rosa Rivera
companions.title: The Negotiator
companions.backstory: Community organizer. Can talk anyone into anything. Or out of it.

companions.name: Tony Jr.
companions.title: The Heir
companions.backstory: Old family name, new world. Trying to build something that lasts longer than his father's empire did.

companions.name: Deshawn Williams
companions.title: The Mechanic
companions.backstory: Can fix anything with wheels. Learned in his uncle's shop, perfected on the road.

companions.name: Yuki Tanaka
companions.title: The Blade
companions.backstory: Kendo champion. Her katana is family steel, folded a thousand times. So is she.

companions.name: Carlos Mendez
companions.title: The Smuggler
companions.backstory: Moved product across the border for years. Now moves it across county lines. Same skills.

companions.name: Natasha Petrova
companions.title: The Medic
companions.backstory: Combat medic, two tours. Seen worse than this. Probably.

companions.name: Fritz Weber
companions.title: The Builder
companions.backstory: Master carpenter. Built half the barns in Boone County. Now builds barricades.

companions.name: Keisha Johnson
companions.title: The Runner
companions.backstory: Track star, state finals. Now runs messages no one else can deliver.

companions.name: Marley Brown
companions.title: The Peacemaker
companions.backstory: Was a don's right hand. Walked away. Now tries to keep the peace he used to break.
